tagline: Run real physics, change the world, and compare what happens next

examples.prompt: Load the Unitree Go2 in MuJoCo. Let me pin a moment, apply a 100 N sideways shove for 0.15 seconds and compare the next three seconds with the original world. I want to inspect the greatest measured difference and keep a reproducible experiment.
examples.caption: Real Go2 session · 100 N shove · compare two futures and keep the experiment

examples.prompt: Make the Unitree G1 humanoid say hello: stand, raise its right hand and wave three times, then lower it and take a small bow. Record it.
examples.caption: Unitree G1 humanoid · wave hello + bow · 29 servos, 11 s rollout, live in the MuJoCo Viewer

examples.prompt: Load the Unitree Go2, make it stand, then do three slow squats and wave the front left leg. Record it.
examples.caption: Unitree Go2 · 3 squats + a wave · 21 s rollout, live in the MuJoCo Viewer

examples.prompt: Load the Unitree Go2 and make it stand, then do three slow squats. Record the motion so I can open What if, change the surface friction and compare what happens from the same moment.
examples.caption: A reproducible physics experiment and measurements CSV.
